description: We are going to create a Health Monitoring Software For Astronauts
summary: ASTRO-PULSE is an intelligent health monitoring system designed to protect astronauts during space missions. Our development includes real-time monitoring of six vital health and environmental parameters, interactive biometric dashboards, AI-based medical analysis, emergency alerts, and health recommendations. It also simulates critical space emergencies, helping astronauts respond quickly and safely, especially when communication with Earth is delayed.
details:
ASTRO-PULSE – Project Details

Project Overview

Our project, ASTRO-PULSE, is designed to monitor astronauts' health during space missions. It checks six important things: heart rate, oxygen level, radiation, CO2 level, body temperature, and stress. It displays the readings on a dashboard and alerts us if something is wrong.

Benefits

It helps astronauts keep track of their health and identify problems early. It also gives emergency alerts and medical suggestions when astronauts need help.

Intended Impact

Our main aim is to make space missions safer for astronauts. We want to help them understand their health conditions and take quick action during emergencies, especially when communication with Earth is delayed.

Tools and Technologies

We used HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Chart.js, and Font Awesome to develop our website. Currently, it uses sample sensor data and does not require physical hardware.

Creativity

Our project combines astronaut health monitoring and AI-based medical assistance in one website. The ASTROMED-AI feature provides medical suggestions, while the dashboard displays health conditions and emergency alerts.

Factors Considered

We mainly focused on astronaut safety, health conditions, oxygen levels, radiation, body temperature, stress, emergency situations, and communication delays between Earth and space.

Our Goal

Our main goal is to help astronauts stay healthy and safe while exploring space.
